我希望你重新调整一下 figure 的叙事顺序：
1. 文章第一页附近应该放一个真正的“problem illustration”图，用一个具体例子解释本文研究的问题是什么。IE/schema/type/confusability 对很多 reviewer 来说并不是默认熟悉的概念，所以这个图要帮读者建立直觉，而不是一上来就给 pipeline。
这个图最好展示：
  - 一段输入文本；
  - 一个小 schema 和一个大 schema；
  - count 维度：候选 type 数量变多；
  - confusability 维度：候选 type 语义很接近；
  - 一个具体错误例子，例如 gold relation 是 place of birth，模型预测成 residence 或类似的 confusable relation。
目标是让读者一眼看懂：本文研究的是“为什么 training-free LLM IE 在 schema 变复杂时退化”，以及复杂度来自两个因素：type count 和 inter-type confusability。
2. 现在的 Figure 1 不要放在 introduction 前面。它应该移动到 §5 Schema Decomposition 附近，因为它解释的是 decomposition 为什么失败：RE 中 routing failure，NER/ED 中 merge amplification。这个图作为 §5 的解释图是合适的，但不适合作为全文第一张图。
3. 现在的 Figure 2 更像 experimental design overview，可以保留在 §3 或相关位置。它适合解释 count × BCS 的 controlled batch design，但它仍然偏统计图，不足以替代第一页的问题图。
4. 调整后请同步检查所有 figure 编号、正文引用和 caption。尤其注意不要出现 “Figure 4a” 但图里没有 panel 的情况，也不要出现 caption 中颜色描述和实际图颜色不一致的问题。
整体目标不是增加炫酷图，而是让非 IE 背景的 reviewer 在第一页就知道：
- 输入/输出对象是什么；
- schema 是什么；
- type count 是什么；
- confusable types 长什么样；
- 为什么这个问题值得研究。

#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Problem illustration figure for page 1: two dimensions of schema complexity."""
import matplotlib
matplotlib.use('Agg')
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
from matplotlib.patches import FancyBboxPatch

# ─── Configuration ───
OUT = '/home/ubuntu/.agent-ml-research-idea_gen_0509_18/projects/schema-dag-extraction/figures/paper/fig_problem_illustration.pdf'

C = dict(
    head='#1A5276', tail='#6C3483',
    head_bg='#D4E6F1', tail_bg='#E8DAEF',
    ok='#1E8449', err='#B03A2E',
    sim='#D35400', sim_bg='#FDEBD0',
    panel_bg='#F8F9FA', border='#CCD1D1',
    text='#2C3E50', light='#808B96',
    dim1='#2471A3', dim2='#CA6F1E',
    sent_bg='#EBF5FB',
)

def main():
    fig = plt.figure(figsize=(6.5, 2.9), facecolor='white')
    ax = fig.add_axes([0.0, 0.0, 1.0, 1.0])
    ax.set_xlim(0, 10)
    ax.set_ylim(0, 4.3)
    ax.set_axis_off()

    draw_sentence(ax)
    draw_small_schema(ax)
    draw_large_schema(ax)
    draw_dimensions(ax)

    fig.savefig(OUT, bbox_inches='tight', dpi=300,
                facecolor='white', edgecolor='none', pad_inches=0.03)
    plt.close()
    print(f'Saved to {OUT}')


def draw_sentence(ax):
    """Top sentence bar with highlighted entities."""
    sy = 3.85
    bar = FancyBboxPatch((0.1, 3.58), 9.8, 0.58,
                         boxstyle="round,pad=0.05",
                         fc=C['sent_bg'], ec=C['border'], lw=0.5)
    ax.add_patch(bar)

    ax.text(0.35, sy, 'RE task:', fontsize=6.5, color=C['light'],
            fontweight='bold', va='center', family='sans-serif')

    ax.text(2.3, sy, '"', fontsize=7.5, color=C['text'],
            va='center', ha='right', family='serif')

    # Head entity
    hx1, hx2 = 2.35, 3.85
    hbox = FancyBboxPatch((hx1, 3.66), hx2 - hx1, 0.38,
                          boxstyle="round,pad=0.03",
                          fc=C['head_bg'], ec=C['head'], lw=0.4, alpha=0.8)
    ax.add_patch(hbox)
    ax.text((hx1 + hx2) / 2, sy, 'Barack Obama', fontsize=7, color=C['head'],
            fontweight='bold', ha='center', va='center', family='sans-serif')
    ax.text((hx1 + hx2) / 2, 3.52, 'head', fontsize=5, color=C['head'],
            ha='center', va='top', style='italic')

    ax.text(3.9, sy, ' was born in ', fontsize=7.5, color=C['text'],
            va='center', family='serif')

    # Tail entity
    tx1, tx2 = 5.55, 6.50
    tbox = FancyBboxPatch((tx1, 3.66), tx2 - tx1, 0.38,
                          boxstyle="round,pad=0.03",
                          fc=C['tail_bg'], ec=C['tail'], lw=0.4, alpha=0.8)
    ax.add_patch(tbox)
    ax.text((tx1 + tx2) / 2, sy, 'Honolulu', fontsize=7, color=C['tail'],
            fontweight='bold', ha='center', va='center', family='sans-serif')
    ax.text((tx1 + tx2) / 2, 3.52, 'tail', fontsize=5, color=C['tail'],
            ha='center', va='top', style='italic')

    ax.text(6.55, sy, ', Hawaii."', fontsize=7.5, color=C['text'],
            va='center', family='serif')

    # Gold label
    ax.text(7.8, sy, 'Gold:', fontsize=6.5, color=C['light'],
            fontweight='bold', va='center')
    ax.text(8.35, sy, 'place of birth', fontsize=7, color=C['ok'],
            fontweight='bold', va='center', family='sans-serif')


def draw_small_schema(ax):
    """Left panel: few dissimilar types -> correct."""
    lx, ly, lw, lh = 0.1, 0.65, 4.35, 2.70
    panel = FancyBboxPatch((lx, ly), lw, lh,
                           boxstyle="round,pad=0.08",
                           fc=C['panel_bg'], ec=C['border'], lw=0.7)
    ax.add_patch(panel)

    ax.text(lx + lw / 2, ly + lh - 0.12, 'Few candidate types (k = 4)',
            fontsize=7.5, fontweight='bold', ha='center', va='top',
            color=C['text'], family='sans-serif')

    types = ['place of birth', 'genre', 'manufacturer', 'member of']
    for i, t in enumerate(types):
        y = ly + lh - 0.52 - i * 0.34
        is_gold = (i == 0)
        dot_c = C['ok'] if is_gold else C['light']
        ax.text(lx + 0.35, y, '●', fontsize=5.5, color=dot_c,
                va='center')
        ax.text(lx + 0.58, y, t, fontsize=7, color=C['text'],
                va='center', family='sans-serif',
                fontweight='bold' if is_gold else 'normal')

    sep_y = ly + 0.72
    ax.plot([lx + 0.25, lx + lw - 0.25], [sep_y, sep_y],
            color=C['border'], lw=0.4, ls='--')

    ax.text(lx + 0.30, ly + 0.40, 'Prediction:', fontsize=6.5,
            color=C['light'], va='center', fontweight='bold')
    ax.text(lx + 1.45, ly + 0.40, 'place of birth', fontsize=7.5,
            color=C['ok'], va='center', fontweight='bold', family='sans-serif')
    ax.text(lx + lw - 0.25, ly + 0.40, '✓', fontsize=12, color=C['ok'],
            ha='right', va='center', fontweight='bold')


def draw_large_schema(ax):
    """Right panel: many confusable types -> wrong (substitution)."""
    rx, ry, rw, rh = 5.55, 0.65, 4.35, 2.70
    panel = FancyBboxPatch((rx, ry), rw, rh,
                           boxstyle="round,pad=0.08",
                           fc=C['panel_bg'], ec=C['border'], lw=0.7)
    ax.add_patch(panel)

    ax.text(rx + rw / 2, ry + rh - 0.12, 'Many candidate types (k = 80)',
            fontsize=7.5, fontweight='bold', ha='center', va='top',
            color=C['text'], family='sans-serif')

    types = [
        ('place of birth',         False, False),
        ('place of death',         True,  False),
        ('residence',              True,  True),   # model picks this
        ('headquarters location',  True,  False),
        ('country of citizenship', True,  False),
        ('genre',                  False, False),
        ('... + 74 more types',    False, False),
    ]

    for i, (t, is_sim, is_pred) in enumerate(types):
        y = ry + rh - 0.52 - i * 0.28
        if is_sim:
            hl = FancyBboxPatch((rx + 0.20, y - 0.11), 3.15, 0.23,
                                boxstyle="round,pad=0.02",
                                fc=C['sim_bg'], ec='none')
            ax.add_patch(hl)

        if t.startswith('...'):
            ax.text(rx + 0.38, y, t, fontsize=6, color=C['light'],
                    va='center', family='sans-serif', style='italic')
        else:
            dot_c = C['err'] if is_pred else (C['sim'] if is_sim else C['light'])
            dot = '●' if (is_pred or i == 0) else '○'
            tc   = C['err'] if is_pred else (C['sim'] if is_sim else C['text'])
            ax.text(rx + 0.35, y, dot, fontsize=5.5, color=dot_c, va='center')
            ax.text(rx + 0.58, y, t, fontsize=7, color=tc,
                    va='center', family='sans-serif',
                    fontweight='bold' if is_pred else 'normal')

    # Bracket grouping confusable types
    by_top = ry + rh - 0.52 - 1 * 0.28 + 0.12
    by_bot = ry + rh - 0.52 - 4 * 0.28 - 0.12
    bx = rx + 3.45
    ax.plot([bx, bx + 0.12, bx + 0.12, bx],
            [by_top, by_top, by_bot, by_bot],
            color=C['sim'], lw=0.7, solid_capstyle='round')
    ax.text(bx + 0.18, (by_top + by_bot) / 2, 'semantically\nsimilar',
            fontsize=5.5, color=C['sim'], va='center',
            style='italic', linespacing=1.15)

    sep_y = ry + 0.72
    ax.plot([rx + 0.25, rx + rw - 0.25], [sep_y, sep_y],
            color=C['border'], lw=0.4, ls='--')

    ax.text(rx + 0.30, ry + 0.40, 'Prediction:', fontsize=6.5,
            color=C['light'], va='center', fontweight='bold')
    ax.text(rx + 1.45, ry + 0.40, 'residence', fontsize=7.5,
            color=C['err'], va='center', fontweight='bold', family='sans-serif')
    ax.text(rx + rw - 0.25, ry + 0.40, '✗', fontsize=12, color=C['err'],
            ha='right', va='center', fontweight='bold')


def draw_dimensions(ax):
    """Dimension annotations between/below panels."""
    # Center arrow between panels
    ax.annotate('', xy=(5.35, 2.0), xytext=(4.65, 2.0),
                arrowprops=dict(arrowstyle='->', color=C['dim1'],
                               lw=1.5, mutation_scale=12))

    # Dimension 1 label below center arrow
    ax.text(5.0, 1.58, 'Dim 1:\ntype count',
            fontsize=6, color=C['dim1'], fontweight='bold',
            ha='center', va='top', family='sans-serif',
            linespacing=1.1)

    # Dimension 2 label: small callout near the bracket
    # Use an arrow from a label box to the confusable region
    ax.annotate('Dim 2: confusability',
                xy=(9.0, 2.55), xytext=(5.0, 0.30),
                fontsize=6, color=C['dim2'], fontweight='bold',
                family='sans-serif',
                ha='center',
                arrowprops=dict(arrowstyle='->', color=C['dim2'],
                               lw=0.8, connectionstyle='arc3,rad=-0.2'))


if __name__ == '__main__':
    main()
